aboutTitle: What does the Domain Age Checker show?
about: The Domain Age Checker looks up a domain's public registration record. When the registry provides the information, the result shows its registration date, calculated age, expiry date, last update and registrar.
exampleTitle: How to check a domain — an example
example: Enter example.com or https://example.com and select Check Domain Age. Review the registration date and calculated age in the result. Dates and other details depend on what the registry publishes.

faqs.question: How is domain age calculated?
faqs.answer: The tool calculates the time between the registration date returned by the registry and the date of your check.

faqs.question: Why are some registration details missing?
faqs.answer: A registry may not publish every field. If a date is missing, the tool shows that it is not published instead of estimating it.

faqs.question: Does domain age show when a website first went online?
faqs.answer: The registration date records when the domain was registered. A website may have launched later, and its content or owner may have changed since then.
